falsifierMarked390.preRegistered: CP4 step6Probe.halfC: 305 marked accounts served a real cadRoll dollar pre-publish; 'the post-publish re-run of this same query is the falsifier: it must go to 0, or the marker is not in the read path.'
falsifierMarked390.all390WereRewrittenThisRun: 390 of 390 marked snapshots carry updated_at in 03:01:49..03:36:14Z (i.e. this publish DID rewrite them; it did not skip them).
falsifierMarked390.reading: The re-bake re-derived real cad_property dollars for the marked rows. The bake has NO absent-awareness, so 'absent-from-declared-drop' cannot suppress the dollar. The marker is NOT in the bake/serve path as deployed.

rootCause.claim: The factory publish image bundles LDT's conformant bake CLI at a pinned LDT SHA that PREDATES P-178's serve-side fixes. The bake therefore cannot honour cad_property.roll_membership.

whereTheMarkerActuallyLives.bothAreInsideBundledLDT: Both live under artifacts/api-server/src, i.e. inside the LDT tree this image bundles -- so both are stale at pin 6ae7ef57.

whyThisIsTheServedSurface.cadRollSource: assembleNodeBriefBody loads loadBakedNodeFacetSnapshot(parcelNodeId) -- the BAKED snapshot -- and overlays resolveCadRollOverlaysForServe(countyFips, propId)
whyThisIsTheServedSurface.overlayIsParcelRecordNotCadProperty: cadRollServeCutover.ts header: 'marketValue/assessedValue/landValue/improvementValue are baked into place_layer_snapshots (facets.baseFacts.cadRoll.*) by an offline job, not read live -- the legacy value is whatever the last bake wrote.' The overlay only replaces a rail where resolveAllowlist(...) === 'record' (a parcel_record cutover), and it does NOT route through isAbsentFromDeclaredDrop.
whyThisIsTheServedSurface.conclusion: For Hays, absent a dollar-rail cutover, the dollars Smart Site reads ARE the last bake's. So the marker has no route to the served surface until the bake image is rebuilt on a post-#677 LDT SHA.

consequence.productionPublishMustNotFire: Firing it would write serving stores with the SAME stale bake logic and would NOT move the falsifier (it would cost the same ~38 min and a production write for zero effect). Hard stop held.
consequence.notAFalsifierRefutation: The falsifier was correctly specified; it is red for a real, external reason, not because the probe was wrong.

remedyOptions.A_bumpTheFactoryLdtPin: Raise cloudbuild.publish.yaml _LDT_SHA past #677 in hauska-factory, rebuild + redeploy factory-bastrop-publish, re-run the staging publish, and re-check 305 -> 0. The 'right' fix; note the repo's own CI guard ('fails a pull_request or push whose diff changes _LDT_SHA's graph, line ~221) and that a sibling lane (fix/p180-hays-cells-crosswalk) is active on this repo.
remedyOptions.B_runThePatchCli: Run LDT's nodeFacetPatchCadRollFromCadPropertyCli from a post-#677 image (e.g. the cortex-api image just deployed) against the target to re-null cadRoll for marked rows without a full re-bake. Narrower, but a targeted repair rather than the intended path.
remedyOptions.note: Neither was executed: both are cross-repo/scope decisions for the operator.
